campaign.title: Makati Public Park Accessibility Check
campaign.shortDescription: A 2026 pilot collecting structured accessibility observations across the 13 verified current government/public parks in the reconciled BetterMakati park inventory.

geography.label: 13 verified current government/public parks in Makati
geography.scopeStatement: Covers the 13 current government/public park entities frozen from BetterMakati's September 25, 2026 official-source reconciliation. It does not include privately managed public-access parks, unresolved historical park identities, former-Makati parks, future parks or unnamed parks appearing only in headline counts.

period.observationFreshnessRule: Only observations whose observedAt falls within the campaign period count toward campaign completion.

completion.entityCompleteRule: A target park is complete when it has at least two campaign-period observations and each of the four required accessibility questions has at least one substantive answer.
completion.campaignCompleteRule: The pilot is operationally complete when all 13 target parks meet the entity-complete rule or the period ends. Period end does not imply full coverage.

collection.dataSource: Existing /api/civic-observation records are counted by frozen entityId + observedAt window; no separate campaign response store is created.
collection.problemReports: Remain separate civic cases and never count as audit observations.
collection.formBehavior: When opened from the pilot page, the existing observation form is limited to the four campaign question IDs. Normal park pages retain the full park observation question set.

nextStep.title: Publish one audit output
nextStep.constraint: Use only the frozen 13-park target set and campaign-period structured observations. Publish coverage, dates, sample counts and question-level distributions; no composite scores or rankings.
